title: BestConfigAgentHeadConfig
description: Response of GET /api/v1/best-configs/agent-heads/{agent_ref}/config. CARRIES CUSTOMER CONTENT (the stored config); it is outside the closed reactive contract and outside the Director bridge guarantee.

spec.description: The serialized spec of EXACTLY the pinned version (customer content: config_id, environment and config knob names/values are content; plan 8.4).

AgentHeadConfigResponse.description: Exact pinned best-config version of an agent head, read with its generation in one read (ETag = generation). Unlike the config GET (current version) and the listing (no spec), this returns the version the head pins.

expected_head_generation.description: The head generation READ AT APPROVAL and bound in the grant (plan 8.3); must equal grant.deploy.expected_head_generation. NOT the generation captured at optimization start.

spec.description: The candidate configuration to publish (customer content, plan 8.4).

DeployPublishRequest.description: Deploy publication request. Bindings: grant (valid at server time, effect deploy, contract current), reservation holder generation, and an idempotency key equal to deploy:{attempt_ref}:{grant candidate fingerprint}:{grant gate-result digest}. CARRIES CUSTOMER CONTENT in `spec`.
